question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**would**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the first clause of the sentence is in the **past tense** which is connected by the conjunction "and".
 
• As a result, the clause after the conjunction will also be in the past tense.
 
• The verb "**would" **is the past tense of will.
 
• In the given sentence, "**would"** indicates **habitual past action**.
 
• As a result of the ongoing treatments, people would keep needing platelets.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.**

**The complete passage is: **During the pandemic, Suren, a regular platelet donor, was stuck outside Mumbai for 14 weeks. A constant thought was the missed donation dates. He **(1) knew** there would be a need because, **(2) despite** the lockdown restrictions, people on chemotherapy were being treated and **(3) would **keep needing platelets. When he returned home, he discovered that the situation was grim as many regular donors **(4) had stopped** coming either out of fear or because travel was difficult. So, he formed a small **(5) group** of donors, arranged for transport and letters from TMC Hospital to validate our travel and they started donating in July 2020.
